business_scope.primary_industry_name: Certified Good Distribution Practice (GDP) Clinical Logistics

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Taiwan (cross-Strait foreign investor source jurisdiction); WFOE to be incorporated in mainland China
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Cross-Strait Economic Cooperation Framework Agreement (ECFA), signed by ARATS and SEF on 29 June 2010
Cross-Strait Investment Protection and Promotion Agreement, signed 9 August 2012, effective 1 February 2013
Cross-Strait Agreement on Avoidance of Double Taxation and Tax Cooperation, signed 25 August 2015

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: People's Republic of China Foreign Investment Law (2019, effective 1 January 2020); Implementing Regulations of the Foreign Investment Law (State Council Order No. 723); PRC Company Law (2023 revision, effective 1 July 2024); PRC Anti-Money Laundering Law (as revised); Measures for the Administration of Beneficial Owner Information jointly issued by PBOC and SAMR (Order No. 3, effective 1 November 2024); Regulations on the Administration of Market Entity Registration (State Council Order No. 746, 2021); Interim Provisions on Enterprise Name Registration Administration (SAMR Order No. 34, 2021); Good Supply Practice for Pharmaceutical Products and Good Distribution Practice regulations of the National Medical Products Administration; customs and tax registration requirements applicable to licensed logistics and freight forwarding.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation (PRC Business License) and Registration Dossier
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR), local district-level Market Regulation Administration
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization by PRC notary public; if destination is a Hague Apostille Convention state, authenticate solely by apostille issued by PRC MOFA or authorized provincial Foreign Affairs Office; if destination is a non-Convention state, authenticate solely by MOFA authentication followed by destination consular legalization. The two routes are parallel and mutually exclusive; never chain them.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing equivalent (SAMR Enterprise Credit Information Public Report and tax clearance certificate)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) and State Taxation Administration (STA) local competent tax bureau
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarize the original report, then apply to PRC MOFA or authorized provincial Foreign Affairs Office for apostille if the destination is a Hague Apostille Convention state; for a non-Hague destination, use MOFA authentication followed by destination consular legalization only. Do not sequence apostille and consular legalization.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution and Power of Attorney (PoA) for WFOE incorporation signatories
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign investor board of directors and authorized representative; where the investor is a Taiwan company, the board resolution originates in Taiwan
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: For Taiwan-origin documents, use Taiwan notarization, Straits Exchange Foundation (SEF) verification, and Association for Relations Across the Taiwan Strait (ARATS) processing in the mainland; this special cross-Strait route is not a Hague apostille and not consular legalization and must not be chained with either. For mainland-origin documents, use the PRC apostille or PRC MOFA plus consular legalization route as applicable.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: WFOE shareholders' meeting, filed and stamped by SAMR
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarize the SAMR-filed copy; then apply for PRC MOFA apostille for Hague Convention destinations, or PRC MOFA authentication plus destination consular legalization for non-Convention destinations. The routes are mutually exclusive and must never be used sequentially.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter (AML/KYC relationship and payment clearance)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: PRC licensed commercial bank holding the preliminary corporate account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Bank letter on original bank letterhead, notarized by PRC notary public, then PRC MOFA apostille for Hague Convention states or PRC MOFA authentication plus destination consular legalization for non-Hague Convention states. No combination of apostille and consular legalization is permissible.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO Identification Pack and Taiwan Parent Company Registration Extract
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA) commercial registration authority and Taiwan household registration office
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Taiwan notarization followed by Straits Exchange Foundation (SEF) verification and ARATS verification in the PRC; this is the cross-Strait authentication route and is distinct from Hague apostille and consular legalization; it is not chained with either route.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All legal persons and individuals holding direct or indirect 25 percent or more equity or voting rights, directors, senior managers, authorized signatories, freight forwarders, logistics partners and beneficial operators must be screened against the PRC domestic list of persons subject to anti-money laundering countermeasures, the PBOC terrorist financing list, OFAC SDN list, UN Security Council consolidated sanctions lists, China's sanctions list, Taiwan regulatory advisories, and international financial intelligence advisories. Enhanced due diligence is mandatory for politically exposed persons (PEPs), individuals with adverse media, dual citizens, persons connected to high-risk jurisdictions, sanctioned industries, customs integrity violations, or pharmaceutical regulatory sanctions. Screening must be repeated at onboarding, before each licensing submission, before bank account opening, and on a rolling 24-hour trigger basis; results must be documented and retained for at least five years after the relationship closes.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) National Enterprise Name Registration and Search System, accessed through the local provincial or municipal Market Regulation Administration online service portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The PRC enterprise legal name must be in standardized simplified Chinese characters and must follow the four-tier statutory naming formula: administrative division plus distinctive trade name (at least two Chinese characters) plus industry or business characteristics plus organizational form, namely Limited Liability Company. A romanized English name or pinyin transliteration may be used in parallel for foreign communication, banking, customs and cross-border contracts, but it must be clearly consistent with the registered Chinese legal name and must not contain misleading numbers, Latin words as the core Chinese name, or state-affiliated wording. For Taiwan investors, the Chinese-language corporate name should be converted to simplified Chinese characters and supported by notarized cross-Strait documentation so that the Chinese company registry, tax authority, customs and banks recognize the same legal person.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Within 15 working days of receiving a SAMR name rejection, the applicant may file a written administrative reconsideration application with the superior market regulation administration or the municipal SAMR that issued the rejection, attaching the entire application package, the proposed corrected name, any prior trademark registration, and a written explanation of the distinctive meaning of the trade name. If reconsideration is unsuccessful, the applicant may bring an administrative lawsuit in the competent people's court within six months. Before the 30-day reservation window expires, the applicant may request a single extension if the incorporation package is awaiting regulatory approval; otherwise a new name reservation application must be filed. The appeal process should first remove any prohibited token, adjust the four-tier naming structure, and rerun the SAMR artificial intelligence conflict check to eliminate duplication.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office or commercial mailbox is effectively rejected for this industry. A WFOE engaged in certified GDP pharmaceutical freight must maintain a physical registered office and operational premises with cold-chain or temperature-controlled handling capacity, quarantine and monitoring equipment, licensed personnel, and auditable SOPs. Local tax authorities will reject a purely virtual address for VAT, corporate income tax and customs registration, and PRC banks will not complete AML/KYC account opening without a verifiable physical site, lease agreement in the company name, utility invoices and site inspection evidence. Some city-level clustered registration policies may permit non-operational virtual addresses only for consulting or e-commerce, but not for licensed pharmaceutical logistics, freight forwarding, customs AEO or GDP operations. Therefore, a genuine lease of physical premises is mandatory.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Likelihood: high; quantified risk score 88 out of 100 within the first 12 months for a licensed GDP pharma freight WFOE. Triggering events include application for the pharmaceutical logistics or distribution license, VAT general taxpayer designation, bank account opening, customs registration, AEO application, and any cold-chain temperature excursion. On-site inspection checklist: registered office signboard matching the Chinese legal name; original lease and rental invoices; legal representative and UBO identity; board resolutions; temperature-controlled storage; qualified vehicles; GPS and temperature logs; personnel licenses; GDP SOPs; contamination-control records; pharmaceutical transport records

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Act of Taiwan, as amended, Articles 98, 100, 101, 108, and 113; regulations on company registration; regulations on foreign/Mainland investment; and, for the specific pharmaceutical logistics operations, the Pharmaceutical Affairs Act and applicable Good Distribution Practice (GDP) rules
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Department of Commercial Affairs, Ministry of Economic Affairs, Taipei, Taiwan; Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs for the required foreign/Mainland investment permission
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Registration of a Limited Company and the approved Articles of Incorporation, accompanied by the investment permission letter and capital verification report
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-in capital applies to an ordinary limited company under the Company Act of Taiwan; the subscribed capital must be fully contributed before registration and verified by a certified public accountant. No blocked escrow account is required, but the investment capital must first be approved by the Investment Commission, remitted through an authorized foreign-exchange bank, settled into New Taiwan dollars, and held in the Taiwanese corporate account before a capital verification report can be issued.

WHEREAS the Company has been formed under the laws of Taiwan and will be registered under the Company Act of Taiwan; WHEREAS the Company's proposed business scope comprises certified Good Distribution Practice (GDP) clinical logistics, pharmaceutical freight validation, temperature-controlled transport management, and ancillary warehousing services in conformity with ISIC 5229; WHEREAS the Investment Commission has approved the proposed foreign or Mainland shareholder structure and capital amount; WHEREAS the Articles of Incorporation create an initial authorized share capital of NT$[X], divided into [X] ordinary shares of NT$[X] par value each; WHEREAS the sole shareholder has subscribed for all issued shares and has caused the full subscription price to be credited to the Company's capital contribution account; WHEREAS the Company has secured a registered office at [ADDRESS]; AND WHEREAS this resolution is adopted by unanimous written consent and shall be filed in the corporate minute book. Seal, Books, and Corporate Authority. The corporate seal is adopted; instruments are binding only when signed by an authorized officer or affixed with the corporate seal. 6. Professional Advisors. national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration of the People's Republic of China (STA), administered through the nationwide electronic e-Tax online service platform and the STA official web portal at www.chinatax.gov.cn
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: (1) Foreign corporate shareholders submit notarized and apostilled constitutional documents, board resolutions, and passports/officer identification to the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) through the local integrated government service platform. (2) Upon incorporation of the Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise (WFOE) as a Limited Liability company, SAMR issues a Business License bearing the Uniform Social Credit Code (USCC), which is automatically recognized by the STA as the enterprise Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN). (3) SAMR electronically notifies the STA of the new legal entity, and the WFOE must complete supplementary tax registration through e-Tax within 30 days, confirming permanent address, bank account information, legal representative, accounting standards, and the intended VAT taxpayer status. (4) The WFOE may then elect to register either as a small-scale VAT taxpayer or as a general VAT taxpayer in accordance with the PRC VAT regulations. (5) For foreign non-resident entities with no Chinese establishment, a non-resident taxpayer registration must be completed through e-Tax where a direct Chinese-source withholding obligation arises, and the foreign parent company may additionally apply for a Certificate of Tax Residency in its home jurisdiction to claim treaty benefits. (6) Any change to registration data, including capital investors, directors, business scope, or bank account, must be reported to the STA through e-Tax within 30 days of the change.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None - the PRC does not provide a US-style check-the-box election or hybrid mismatch election. The only material election available to the WFOE is the voluntary registration as a general VAT taxpayer before exceeding the statutory threshold; corporate income tax classification remains entity-level and mandatory for all Chinese resident enterprises.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value-Added Tax (VAT) under the PRC Value-Added Tax Law, its Implementing Regulations, and the STA's electronic invoice administration measures
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: CNY 5,000,000 of annual taxable turnover: exceeding this threshold makes general VAT taxpayer registration mandatory; businesses below the threshold may remain small-scale VAT taxpayers, while non-resident suppliers with Chinese-source taxable services may be required to register through e-Tax or rely on a withholding agent
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: China mandates the issuance of fully digitalized electronic invoices (TDEI) through the STA national electronic invoice platform, requiring near-real-time API transmission of invoice data to the tax authority. Each invoice carries a unique nationwide invoice number and digital QR anti-fraud mark, and the Golden Tax Phase IV system performs automated cross-verification of invoice issuance, VAT filings, customs export declarations, and foreign exchange collection records.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero rating applies where goods are physically exported from the PRC customs territory under a valid customs export declaration, title and risk have passed to an overseas buyer, the export consideration is received and repatriated in the invoiced currency within the statutory period, and the exporter retains the full documentary chain proving the export and payment. Qualifying offshore services, including international freight transportation and logistics/services supplied to non-resident customers where the benefit is wholly received outside China, may also be zero-rated under applicable STA export VAT rules (including Caishui [2016] No.36), provided the service recipient is a non-resident entity, the service is consumed outside China, and foreign exchange is received for the service. For GDP pharma freight, the exporter must additionally evidence the controlled-temperature logistics service through GDP-compliant cold-chain monitoring records.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration Form (customs clearance bill of entry)
Master and house Bill of Lading, airway bill, or equivalent cargo receipt evidencing physical departure from Chinese customs territory
Inward Remittance Certificate (FIRC) or the SAFE foreign exchange collection verification record evidencing actual repatriation of export proceeds
Commercial invoice issued in accordance with PRC export invoicing rules and VAT zero-rating documentation requirements
Original export sales contract and, for GDP pharma freight, the freight/logistics service agreement
Temperature excursion-free GDP monitoring logs and quality validation records substantiating the certified pharmaceutical logistics service
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The STA, in coordination with customs and the State Administration of Foreign Exchange, may deny or claw back any zero-rated VAT refund where physical export, service offshoring, or currency repatriation cannot be substantiated. The exporter must return the VAT refund received, pay interest and late-payment surcharges, and is exposed to administrative penalties ranging from 50 percent to five times the tax evaded under the PRC Tax Collection and Administration Law. Fraudulent or fictitious export VAT refund claims may also constitute criminal export tax refund fraud under Article 204 of the PRC Criminal Law, carrying imprisonment up to life in extremely serious cases, fines, and confiscation of property. The statutory audit scrutiny period generally extends three years, or ten years for fraud or deliberate evasion, and the Golden Tax Phase IV data-matching system continuously cross-checks invoices, customs exit records, logistics bills, and foreign exchange collection records.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: People's Bank of China (PBOC) with delegated foreign exchange administration by the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The currency convertibility framework applicable to a China-incorporated WFOE is governed by the People's Bank of China and its foreign exchange administrator, SAFE. China maintains current account convertibility under Article VIII of the IMF Articles of Agreement; trade-related payments, freight charges, insurance, and logistics fees can be converted and remitted with genuine supporting contracts and customs declarations. The capital account, by contrast, remains heavily managed. Equity capital received from the Taiwan shareholder must be injected through a designated foreign exchange capital account after FDI registration, and any subsequent conversion into RMB is subject to the 'FDI capital settlement' regime and the negative list for foreign investment. Dividend remittances are permissible after annual audit, tax clearance, and proof of distributable profits, but require formal board resolutions and tax refund or withholding certificates. Surplus capital pending use cannot be diverted into securities, entrusted loans, or domestic real estate without specific SAFE approvals. The WFOE will also need to comply with SAFE's cross-border payment reporting, entity annual FDI reports, and bank-based verification for every current account transaction. Overall, the RMB is not freely convertible on capital account; operational liquidity inside China is stable, but exits require documentary substantiation.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory conversion ratio applies to export foreign currency receipts under the current SAFE trade-in-goods reform; 100% of proceeds may be retained in a licensed foreign exchange settlement account or voluntarily converted into CNY. Export proceeds must be repatriated into a domestic foreign exchange account by the contractually agreed payment maturity, and the receipt and payment data aggregate is monitored by SAFE. Where a payment is not received within 90 days after export customs clearance, the exporter must register the overdue or deferred trade receivable in the SAFE Trade Monitoring System and provide relevant credit-term documentation; otherwise the bank may suspend current-account settlement.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: FDI Foreign Exchange Capital Escrow Account / Basic Operational Currency Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: FDI Foreign Exchange Capital Escrow Account / Basic Operational Currency Account
Basic Operational Currency Account / Trade Settlement Collection Account
Basic Operational Currency Account / RMB Settlement Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Offshore digital EMI entities are not viable as a primary banking rail for a China WFOE. PBOC and SAFE do not recognise foreign fintech EMI licences as bank licences in China, and such EMIs are legally barred from opening domestic RMB or foreign exchange settlement accounts, from holding FDI capital, and from performing SAFE capital verification, tax filing, or regulatory reporting. They may only function as an ancillary low-value collection utility where they partner with a licensed Chinese payment institution, but they cannot replace the Tier-1 PRC bank for statutory capital injection, clearing, or treasury concentration.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: The statutory legal representative and, where requested, the KYC officer must physically appear in-branch at the licensed PRC bank for the account opening and KYC interview. Remote consular proxy opening is not generally accepted for a WFOE's onshore RMB or foreign exchange capital account. If the Taiwan investor's corporate documents require cross-strait authentication, those documents must be processed through the designated notarisation and authentication channel before the bank will accept them; the onshore legal representative or jointly authorised Chinese officer must still attend the physical interview.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO ownership opacity: the Taiwan parent's ultimate natural person beneficiaries cannot be clearly identified through public registry, creating a red flag for nominee or shell ownership.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarised charter and shareholders register of the Taiwan investing entity; certified UBO declaration identifying every natural person holding 10% or more; audited Taiwan parent financial statements for the latest three years; Tier-1 Taiwan bank reference; Taiwan office lease and business registration proof.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Business scope mismatch: declared ISIC 5229 freight forwarding combined with pharma GDP logistics may indicate unlicensed pharmaceutical distribution or trade-based money laundering exposure.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current pharmaceutical Good Distribution Practice or drug distribution licence issued by the provincial Medical Products Administration; GDP compliance certificate; pharma logistics quality manual; temperature-controlled transport SOPs; independent audit certificate; cargo-liability insurance policy.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions and proliferation finance exposure: freight and air transshipment lanes touching OFAC or EU embargoed jurisdictions trigger high-risk jurisdiction screening.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete supply chain file including export customs declarations, air waybills, commercial invoices, packing lists, certificates of origin, and lane maps; documented sanctions screening policy; latest OFAC and UN denied-party screening report; customer KYC files with restricted-party declarations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Payment-term anomalies: high advance rates above 70% or third-party payment instructions not matching the named freight contract counterparty create AML layering suspicion.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed freight forwarding and consignment contract with explicit payment schedule; pro forma and final commercial invoices; payment instructions from the named bank account holder only; board resolution approving payment terms; bank statements demonstrating the trade cycle; carrier receipt confirming cargo movement.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The Taiwan shareholder should effect equity injection by SWIFT MT103 wire to the WFOE's SAFE-registered FDI foreign exchange capital account at a licensed PRC Tier-1 bank. The wire must include the unique FDI business registration code obtained through SAFE's foreign direct investment system, state the payment purpose as Inbound Direct Investment Equity Capital, and use the SAFE-designated 6-digit transaction nature code for Inbound Direct Investment Equity Capital Injection as mapped in the settlement bank's reporting menu. The receiving bank verifies the credit against SAFE's electronic data extracts, after which the public accountant issues an independent capital verification report; the funds may then be converted into RMB under the FDI capital settlement regime.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade and freight disbursements may be cleared via SWIFT MT103 for standard cross-border wires, Commercial Letter of Credit (MT700/MT707) for high-value documentary payments, and Documentary Collections (D/P and D/A) for lower-risk settlement. CNY cross-border payments can be routed through the Cross-Border Interbank Payment System (CIPS) with same-day settlement. Each disbursement must be tagged with the underlying service or invoice reference, customs declaration, air/sea waybill, and SAFE transaction code for transportation and logistics to avoid misclassification and AML review delays.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable CNY/USD forward contracts for genuine trade and current-account exposure, with signed underlying logistics or procurement contracts and executed through licensed PRC banks under the real-demand principle.
Cross-currency swaps (including cross-currency interest-rate swaps) for hedging FDI principal and interest only, not for speculative positions.
Simple European-style FX options for hedging projected freight receivables and payables, subject to a bank credit line and underlying documentation.
Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are not permitted for onshore WFOE hedging; any attempt to execute an onshore position through an NDF would violate SAFE real-demand rules.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Company Registration and Substantial Controller Report (Company Annual Report)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Central Company Registration and Information Platform
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 1 July to 30 September of each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: If the report is not filed by 30 September, MOEA will issue a written remediation order with a 15-day curative period. Failure to cure exposes the responsible person to a fine of NT$10,000 (approximately USD 322.58); repeated or aggravated non-compliance may result in escalating fines up to NT$50,000 (approximately USD 1,612.90) and, if the company is also inactive for six consecutive months or more, MOEA may order the company to be administratively dissolved (strike-off).

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Profit-Seeking Enterprise Income Tax Settlement Return and Undistributed Earnings Surcharge Declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Bureau, Ministry of Finance (Taiwan)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 1 May through 31 May for the preceding calendar fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing triggers a 10% additional tax surcharge on the assessed tax; if the tax authority then issues a demand and the return remains unfiled, the surcharge increases to 20%. Unpaid tax is further subject to a late-payment surcharge of 1% for every two days in arrears, capped at 15%, plus collection enforcement measures. Extended non-filing empowers the tax authority to assess tax by available evidence and to pursue the responsible persons personally, with possible strike-off action for companies that fail to file for multiple successive years.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual General Meeting Approval of Audited Financial Statements and Profit Appropriation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Company shareholders (internal corporate act; optional registration with MOEA if the meeting passes amendments to the Articles of Incorporation or changes in directors or supervisors)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months of the fiscal year end, i.e. by 30 June for a calendar-year company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-convening within the six-month window subjects the responsible directors to an administrative fine of NT$20,000 to NT$200,000 (approximately USD 645 to USD 6,452) per violation under the Company Act; the financial statements cannot be lawfully used for profit distribution or dividend payment, and MOEA may treat continuing governance default as evidence of non-operation leading to administrative dissolution.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Foreign Investment Annual Operation Survey (Foreign-Invested Enterprise Annual Report)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA-IC)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 30 June of the year following the reporting fiscal year, or within the deadline fixed in the Investment Approval Letter
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to submit a truthful annual operation survey may result in administrative fines, suspension or revocation of the foreign investment approval certificate, and compulsory transfer or winding-down of the foreign-owned interest. Continued default is a material violation that enables MOEA to declare the WFOE investment void and strike the company from the corporate register.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Pharmaceutical Good Distribution Practice (GDP) Annual Compliance Self-Inspection and Quality-Assurance Declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 calendar days after each anniversary of the GDP license certificate, with a biennial on-site audit inspection cycle
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Missing the self-inspection declaration triggers a regulatory curing order under the Pharmaceutical Affairs Act; continued non-compliance may lead to GDP certificate suspension or revocation, customs entry-hold on pharmaceutical freight, prohibition of contracts with life-science principals, and administrative penalties of up to NT$500,000 (approximately USD 16,129) as well as disqualification of the responsible pharmacist or manager.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A licensed independent CPA audit is legally required for the Taiwan WFOE if, at the balance-sheet date or during the fiscal year, any of the following quantitative thresholds is breached: (a) paid-in capital or total assets exceed NT$30,000,000 (approximately USD 968,000); (b) annual operating revenue exceeds NT$50,000,000 (approximately USD 1,613,000); (c) the average number of full-time employees exceeds 100; or (d) the company is otherwise designated by law, its foreign-investment approval certificate, or the competent authority (for example a GDP pharma freight licensee) as requiring a certified audit. A CPA-attested corporate income tax return is also mandatory for profit-seeking enterprises whose paid-in capital exceeds NT$30 million or whose annual sales revenue exceeds NT$50 million.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: The audited financial statements must be prepared under the Taiwan International Financial Reporting Standards (TIFRS) as endorsed by the Financial Supervisory Commission, for public companies, or the Taiwan SME Enterprise Accounting Standards and local GAAP under the Commercial Accounting Act for private limited companies. For a foreign-invested GDP-logistics entity, the selected framework must be applied consistently, and IFRS reconciliation schedules are necessary if the parent reporting package is prepared under IFRS for Chinese consolidated or cross-border statutory purposes.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under Taiwan Company Act Article 385 and the AML beneficial-ownership regulations,

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% standard PRC Enterprise Income Tax (EIT) rate under Article 4 of the Enterprise Income Tax Law of the People's Republic of China
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No direct tax holiday for GDP pharma freight; potential reductions include 15% for High/New-Technology Enterprises, 10% for encouraged IC/software enterprises, 100% super deduction for qualified R&D expenses (Caishui 2023 No.7), and conditional 15% preferential rate for encouraged industries in Hainan Free Trade Zone; free-zone or patent-box regimes are not generally available for this ISIC code in mainland China

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: PRC Enterprise Income Tax Annual Return (A100000) and Quarterly Prepayment Return (A200000) filed through the State Taxation Administration Electronic Tax System (e-Tax/Electronic Tax Administration)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual return with mandatory quarterly prepayments
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Quarterly prepayments due within 15 days after each quarter-end; annual return due within 5 months of the fiscal year-end, i.e., by 31 May for a 31 December year-end

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating income (revenue from freight, transport, storage and GDP logistics services)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report gross freight revenue net of VAT; reconcile with customs declarations, GDP license endorsements and bank receipts; do not net any Taiwan-related intercompany cost transfers before disclosure

Deduct only expenses supported by Chinese invoice standards (FA Piao) and payment vouchers; any service fee paid to a Taiwan related party must be validated as an actual economic service with substance, documentation, and arm's-length pricing

Apply all permanent and temporary adjustments; if transfer pricing adjustments are required for Taiwan-related freight commissions or logistics fees, the adjustment must be entered here to avoid additional assessment

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Applicable tax rate and calculated tax
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply 25% unless an HNTE or other preferential rate certificate is obtained; for non-resident cross-border activities, the income from Taiwan-sourced operations may require foreign tax credit attachments (A108000)
Offset quarterly prepayments and any foreign tax credit for Taiwan taxes paid on Taiwan-source income; attach proof of payment and translation certification for Taiwanese tax documents

Disclose all intercompany transactions with the Taiwan parent or sister company; if thresholds in SAT Public Notice 2016 No.42 are exceeded, attach Local File and Master File simultaneously; failure triggers special tax adjustment
Pay any balance due by 31 May; if an overpayment exists, claim a refund or offset against future CIT; for non-resident shareholders, no refund is available on withholding tax once remitted

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Memo on planned non-resident profit distribution
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the Board has resolved or contemplates a dividend to the Taiwan parent, record the amount and date; the separate non-resident withholding return must be filed and tax paid within 15 days of distribution

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Audit trail and contemporaneous TP documentation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach a statement confirming the availability of transfer pricing documentation for Taiwan-related controlled transactions; if the Tax Bureau requests it and the file is absent, penalties apply automatically

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the annual return attracts a fine of RMB 2,000 up to RMB 10,000 under TCAL Article 62; serious cases can incur RMB 10,000 to RMB 50,000; late payment is subject to a daily surcharge of 0.05% of the unpaid tax; tax evasion under TCAL Article 63 triggers a penalty of 50%-500% of the underpaid tax and, if criminal, imprisonment under Criminal Law Article 201 for up to 7 years plus fines

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Non-Resident Enterprise Income Tax Withholding Return (Form F100000) filed through the e-Tax portal and remitted through the domestic clearing bank system
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Event-driven per payment/deemed payment of dividends, interest, or royalties to the Taiwan non-resident payee
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 15 days after the date of payment or deemed payment (including board-approved dividend distributions payable abroad); no annual threshold applies

field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the full legal name, Taiwan corporate tax file number, and registered address; obtain and retain a copy of the Taiwan Profit-Seeking Enterprise tax document; do not enter a PRC taxpayer ID as the payee is non-resident

Select dividend (equity investment return), interest (intercompany loan), or royalty (use of intangible property); for GDP pharma freight, payments for logistics services are not royalties and misclassification will be treated as a filing fraud

Report the gross dividend, interest, or royalty before any PRC tax; for dividends use the full approved distribution amount; for interest/royalty use the contract amount; do not subtract Taiwan withholding tax, overseas expenses, or presumed costs

Enter 10% for dividends, interest, and royalties paid to a Taiwan non-resident enterprise under EIT Law Article 19 and Implementation Regulations Article 91; no treaty reduction is available because the 2015 Cross-Strait Tax Agreement is not yet in force

Calculate tax as gross amount multiplied by 10%; pay in RMB; if converting from foreign currency, use the central parity rate at the date of withholding; retain the bank receipt as the withholding certificate

Leave blank or mark 'No' because no bilateral DTA with Taiwan is effective; do not attach a Taiwan Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) as relief; if the Cross-Strait Agreement later enters force, re-file an amended return and attach the TRC and beneficial ownership declaration

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Beneficial ownership and economic substance declaration
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State that the Taiwan recipient is the ultimate beneficial owner and actually operates a substantive GDP freight company; if the Taiwan entity is a conduit or lacks personnel and assets, the SAT will deny any preferential rate and may impose GAAR re-characterization

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Late or deficient withholding penalty notice
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If filed late or under-declared, the WFOE as withholding agent is liable for the under-withheld tax plus penalties; attach any correction note before assessment to mitigate fraud penalties

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to withhold and remit the non-resident tax subjects the WFOE to an order to pay the shortfall plus a fine of 50%-300% of the under-withheld amount under TCAL Article 64; late remittance triggers a daily surcharge of 0.05%; deliberate false under-declaration of gross dividends exposes the WFOE to TCAL Article 63 evasion penalties and Criminal Law liability for the responsible directors
